changelog.note: 231 (stage E, E4; the owner's decisions of 2026-10-29): `metrics`, the measurements of the long-running processes into a local file (`folder` under the data folder's runs), off by default.

231 (stage E, E1; the owner's decisions of 2026-10-29): `workers`, how many workers may run on the store at once (one by default; each takes its own slot, and only the first runs the scheduled ticks).

231 (the owner's decision after a deleted project folder): the daily backup also takes the machine's local settings (.env with the keys and the second backup location) into local-env.zip, locally and in the second location (backup.with_env: true).
Expose each process's actual PDF memory protection. Optional require_memory_limit refuses parsing without an enforced limit; disabled by default.

040 K2: the local service's limits. It answers only the own machine (a loopback address, Host and Origin checks), a request's body is limited, and documents can be added only from the allowed root folders.
045 K3b: the interface's confidence bands (the values of the V4 fieldConfidence.ts): >= 0.90 confident, >= 0.50 to check, below likely wrong. Display only; the working thresholds stay in policy.json.

061 decision (the owner's): folders and files without a limit — any existing local folder or file may be given, as in the legacy project. The limit can be turned back on with restrict_paths: true; then a path must fall under allowed_roots (+ the legacy data folder, + JAV_API_ROOTS).

064 decision (the owner's): a daily store backup at 12:00 (Windows Task Scheduler, scripts/backup-task.ps1), locally and in a second place, the latest 14 backups kept in both. The process state store is not backed up by default (with_burr: false). The interface warns when the latest successful backup is older than max_age_hours.

067 (the owner's decision: a size and a pixel limit): input limits for every entry point (interface, command line, worker). Text extraction refuses a file larger than max_document_mb and a PDF with more pages than max_document_pages with a named error (the largest of the local store's 988 documents has 37 pages). The review page image is made at a lower resolution above max_page_megapixels, and text recognition does not process such a page (a to-do).

067 (066 Á34): the browser origin by an exact match: the service's own address (the same machine and port as the request's), or a development interface on the dev_origins list (Vite, 5173). Until now a page on any local port was accepted.

070 D backup (the owner's decision): the internal working documents (handoffs, plans, reports, backlog, decisions log; jav/doc_scope.py) are not in git since 2026-09-29, so the daily backup takes them too (with_docs: true), in one compressed file, locally and in the second place.
076: backup.copy_to is null in the tracked file; a machine's second backup location comes from the JAV_BACKUP_COPY_TO environment variable (.env), so no local path goes to GitHub.

077 (J6): the PDF parsers (text layer, OCR page images, review page images) run in an isolated helper process (jav/isolated_pdf.py) with a time limit per request and a memory limit. Over a limit the text extraction fails the item with a named error, without a retry; the OCR page images give a to-do; the review page image a 422. isolated: false runs them in-process, as before.

081 (folder browsing): the Browse buttons open the operating system's own folder or file picker through the local service (jav/local_picker.py), in a separate process, one dialog at a time; a dialog left open longer than picker.timeout_s counts as cancelled.
